primary_sources.read: Retained reading of Theorem 3.43, printed254/PDF263, with pair and Mayer-Vietoris exact sequences. Author-hosted version pinned by hash.
primary_sources.exact_import: Poincare--Lefschetz identification of the boundary image with the intersection radical. Independence of the 2g boundary tori is proved directly by intersections and Mayer-Vietoris in the new note.

new_written_arguments: Invariant first-jet interpolation on every group orbit for k>=2N; stabilizer characters and an incidence dimension count produce a nonempty open set of smooth invariant curves of bidegree(k+1,k-1).
All off-diagonal fixed points are forced onto the curve, diagonal fixed points are avoided when the projective exponent divides k. Total ramification is 2N-2, giving exact quotient genus k(k-2)/N.
Effective left weight one trivializes fibre AND complement families over C*. The fibre compactifies in a rational resolution of (P1xP1)/G and has a boundary component of the computed genus.
The 2g normal-circle tori over handle loops inject into fibre H2 by Mayer-Vietoris because H3 of the rational compactification is zero, and lie in the intersection radical.
The actual pure-safe locus therefore has unbounded invariant boundary image with identity monodromy and zero actual variation, at a uniform weight cutoff independent of k.
essential_boundaries: This is an all-degree geometric barrier, not new single-weight MZ safety. The phases lie in a previously closed one-weight sector.
The result rules out zero invariant boundary space uniformly on the ENTIRE pure locus. It does NOT disprove such a statement on a narrower unresolved candidate locus.
Both complete exceptional MZ cases remain OPEN. The actual variation cycle, rather than the dimension or existence of boundary space, remains the exact finish line.
No expanded generic polynomial, least degree, finite-moment campaign or machine proof of invariant-curve existence/topology is claimed; review stays deferred.
